levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن، نمير

notes: Two branches («ح») meet at «قالا جميعا حدثنا هشام»: the names after that point are the shared tail
«أبي» is the father of Muhammad b. Abdullah b. Numayr, named only by relation; «أبيه» is Hisham's father, likewise relation
The comma inside «بن، نمير» is stray punctuation, kept as written
